stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Doors must be in position 1. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Doors and Lighting must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Doors must not be in position 1.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 1 such orders. "Doors and Lighting must not occupy consecutive positions." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Doors → Sensors → Lighting → Racks → Ventilation

distractorRationale.c: Even with the additional condition, Doors → Sensors → Lighting → Racks → Ventilation is permitted and makes this statement false.
